description: Upload an image, video or audio file (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV, MP3, WAV) to use as sourceImageUrl (or, for audio, sourceAudioUrl) in generate_media. Send the bytes as base64 (or a local filePath when this server runs locally). Requires a "generate" key.

dataBase64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (no data: prefix).

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file. Only available when the MCP server runs on your own machine (stdio).

name: upload_source_media
title: Upload a source file
